why: The carried-Confirm guard listens at window capture for keydown, keypress and keyup (issue #919), and dispose must remove all three. A leaked keypress or keyup listener outlives its HUD and keeps cancelling Enter and Space against that HUD's last arrival.
killedBy: createHud dispose removes every capture-phase window key listener it added, by reference, on dispose
